description: Edit the selected site's draft page at one route, including its copy, sections, product display, forms, and page-local components. Shared component edits may affect other pages using them. Starts an asynchronous internal-agent operation; poll get_agent_session. For corrections, call this same tool with its sessionId and unchanged target. Requires a provisioned site. Source edits may execute in its preview. The Replo agent uses its normal tools and connected integrations to implement and verify the requested changes. Use publish_site separately to make changes public.

instructions.description: Requested changes for this operation only. Include necessary references, not conversation history, credentials, or unrelated personal data.

route.description: Page route within the selected site, such as / or /products/[handle].

sessionId.description: Omit to start this operation. To continue, supply the returned sessionId with the same operation and target; mismatches and legacy sessions are rejected.

name: edit_site_page
title: Edit site page
